svg.title: Four layers of latent information
svg.desc: Four layers: stated and indexed; stated but scattered; unstated connection; unstated implication. Search engines work in layer one, deep research agents in the first two, and LIA in the third and fourth.
svg.text: How far a finding is from being stated. Depth here is distance from the record, not strength of evidence.
A claim that one artifact states outright, so a single lookup can return it.
A claim that no single artifact states, but whose parts are all written down across several artifacts,
vocabularies or formats, so answering a question means collecting and assembling them.
A relationship between artifacts, or encoded in a model trained on them, that no record states.
Each side is on the record, the link between them is not, and the finding is the link itself: that A
A claim, hypothesis, opportunity or question that goes beyond the link, which no artifact contains
and which follows only once such connections are made. This includes questions nobody
Search engines largely operate in the first layer. Layers measure distance from being stated, not evidence strength or validation. Band heights carry no meaning.
